issues.on_page: Security technology supplies 94,780 (Depreciation Fund 'Technology' p7, 'Supplies and materials' p14)
issues.issue: The function is a guess. The matching detail line detail[86] (Depreciation Fund Supplies and materials 94,780) is categorized as support services, so the same spending has two different functions.

issues.extracted: Contra: transfer to Depreciation Fund hidden in general administration
issues.issue: This label is not printed. The contra line and detail[83] ('Transfer to Depreciation Fund hidden in general administration', -100,000) are the extractor's construction from the p7 Reclassifications column. The amount is supported by p7 and p14, and the two lines net to zero.

The printed heading says 'Debt services', but the lines are federal programs (they sum to 297,868 = 'Federal programs' on p7). Federal Programs is defensible but goes against the 'only lines labelled so' rule; applies to detail[73]-[81].
The balance sheet comes from p5, whose fund balance section is also off by 1. The discrepancy entry cites only p2.

issues.on_page: Transfers: General (70,000), Other Governmental 70,000; Total column blank
issues.issue: Transfers are left null because they net to zero in the Total column. The roll-forward is correct, but the gross 70,000 interfund transfer does not show in transfers_in/out.
